about_the_game:
Get ready to explore the Emerald Isle - a land of stunning natural beauty, rich history, and vibrant culture. This map expansion takes you across Ireland and Northern Ireland, offering a diverse and immersive driving journey through rolling green landscapes, scenic coastal roads, and dynamic cities.

From the energetic streets of cities such as Dublin, Belfast, Cork, and Galway to the peaceful charm of rural towns and villages like Killarney, Sligo, Cashel, and Bushmills, the journey offers a balance of urban discovery and countryside serenity. You'll navigate everything from scenic coastal roads – including stretches of the A2 through the Antrim Coast and Glens – to inland routes and major motorways that reflect the island’s diverse terrain.

Along the way, you’ll pass by iconic landmarks and natural wonders, such as the Rock of Cashel, Ben Bulben, Samson & Goliath cranes, and the world-famous Giant’s Causeway. Expect to encounter everything from tranquil farmlands lined with stone walls and hedgerows to wild, untamed stretches of land that showcase the island’s raw beauty – often dotted with sheep and bordered by lush greenery.

City centers in places like Dublin, Cork, and Galway provide an authentic urban atmosphere, while ferry ports such as Rosslare open the door to cross-sea connections. Whether you're hauling goods through a bustling metropolis or navigating a narrow backroad between quiet settlements, there is something new and memorable around every corner.

Keep in mind that everything you see is still a work in progress – and there’s even more to come. Add this map expansion to your Steam wishlist and prepare to uncover the magic of the Emerald Isle.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon RX 460 or Intel HD 630 (2GB VRAM)
  • Hard Drive: 25 GB available space (Euro Truck Simulator 2 base game)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or similar
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon RX 590 (2GB VRAM)
  • Hard Drive: 25 GB available space (Euro Truck Simulator 2 base game)
